# Smile Connection Dental Studio

> Smile Connection Dental Studio is a general and cosmetic dental practice at 197 Lois Ave, Newlands, Pretoria, 0081, Gauteng, South Africa, established in 2009. The practice is led by Dr Eugene Kleynhans (BChD, University of Pretoria, 1995; registered with the Health Professions Council of South Africa). It serves Newlands and Pretoria East, including Lynnwood, Faerie Glen, Garsfontein, Moreleta Park, Menlo Park, Constantia Park and Waterkloof.

- Phone / WhatsApp: 079 471 6319 (+27 79 471 6319)
- Email: mydentist@smileconnection.co.za
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 08:00–17:00, Friday 08:00–13:00, closed Saturday and Sunday
- Emergencies (severe pain or trauma): phone 079 471 6319
- Bookings: phone, WhatsApp, or the form at https://www.smileconnection.co.za/contact-us

## Services

- [Preventive Dentistry](https://www.smileconnection.co.za/preventive-dentistry): Regular check-ups, professional cleanings, fissure sealing and fluoride to keep teeth healthy and catch problems early.
- [Restorative Treatments](https://www.smileconnection.co.za/restorative-treatments): Tooth-coloured fillings, crowns and repairs for damaged or decayed teeth.
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://www.smileconnection.co.za/root-canal-treatment): Gentle, modern root canal therapy to relieve pain and save an infected tooth.
- [Tooth Replacement](https://www.smileconnection.co.za/tooth-replacement): Dental implants, bridges and dentures to replace missing teeth.
- [Smile Makeover](https://www.smileconnection.co.za/smile-makeover): Cosmetic dentistry including porcelain veneers, professional teeth whitening and crowns.
- [Facial Aesthetics](https://www.smileconnection.co.za/facial-aesthetics): Aesthetic care that complements your smile; ask the practice about available options.
